item.title: Don't send the whole city: vector tiles for a map full of buildings
item.description: A change of scene: I’m now at Brightmarbles, working on Savills Maps, a mapping product for Savills, the real-estate company. Think a city map where every building is a shape you can click, with data about it: ownership, use, size, deals. Node.js and TypeScript on the backend, React on the front. After years of exams and queues it’s a very different kind of data, and the first lesson was about volume.
